description: A kart drifts through a snowy village at night, sparks flying. The AI Kids Games logo appears.
Words on screen: “The games kids love. None of the stuff parents don’t.”
Calex Cart (ages 10–14): Karts drift, boost and glide through snowy, neon and canyon tracks. On screen: “Drift, boost and chase the finish.”
TheaBonk (ages 8+): Thea swings her glowing Bonk Ring through a crowd of cartoon monsters, levels up and meets Grumblecap. On screen: “Small hero. Mighty big bonks.”
Vanex Defense (ages 10–14): Towers zap enemies winding through a snowy maze and along a sky road, then a giant boss arrives. On screen: “Build the maze. Hold the line.”
Space Sky (ages 6–10): A rocket flies past a ringed planet, lands on the Moon's glowing pad and explores icy Europa. On screen: “Your rocket. A universe of wonder.”
Light Crossing (ages 6+): Skating through lantern rings on a frozen pond, the island in autumn and a cozy decorated home. On screen: “Make a little island shine.”
Cliff Valley (ages 8–14): Picking ripe crops on the farm, the snowy town square on Starlight Night and the crystal mine. On screen: “Grow a farm, make friends, fix the valley.”
On screen: “No ads. No subscriptions. No sign-ups. No tracking.”
A phone and a tablet show the games played by touch. On screen: “Phones, tablets and computers.”
On screen: “Free and open source. Build your own.”
The end card: “The games kids love. aikids.games. Play free.”
